title: The Rumour That Doubles! GP Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
At nine in the morning one student hears a rumour. Every hour, each person who knows it tells one new friend: 1, 2, 4, 8 ... and ten hours later 1024 people know. In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 8, Sequences and Series) we meet the list that multiplies instead of adds: the geometric progression.

You will watch 1024 dots light up hour by hour, learn the NCERT test for a G.P. (divide each term by the one before it), and change the common ratio r live to see a G.P. grow, stay flat, shrink towards zero or flip its sign. Then we build the general term a(n) = a r^(n - 1) step by step, compare an A.P. and a G.P. side by side, solve a worked example, fix the most common exam mistake with the power n - 1, and solve an original JEE Main pattern question. A recap card and three questions to check yourself close the lesson.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.

In this video:
0:00 The rumour that doubles
0:29 Add or multiply? The ratio test
1:04 Live: change the common ratio
1:32 The general term, step by step
2:05 A.P. vs G.P. side by side
2:43 Worked example: which term is 768?
3:22 Exam trap: r to the power n - 1
3:39 Where it is asked
3:49 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
4:33 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 66): Sum of a GP. Grains on a chessboard: 1, 2, 4, 8 ... how many in all?
